unit.mapping: 1:1 at same logical width; crop px at reference bitmap width 1206

gallery.notes: Horizontal gallery: ~42% content width so two cards fully visible + third peeking. Gap 12. Leading 16; scroll may bleed to screen edge. Free scroll with gentle view-aligned snap.

card.notes: Equal aspect thumbs. Selected border optional accent (green). Corner 16 for small gallery cards (was 24 full-bleed).

jwSideAt1024Px.notes: JW reject metrics on titlebaseline side@1024 (each half width 1024). iPhone column is SoT; Android mirrors 1:1 after dens-norm. Caption gap lock = 20pt (not Android's 10).

screenshotScroll.notes: DEBUG image-save mode hides sections above so 「이미지 저장 방식」 is first under nav (sticky scrollTo tucked the title off). settings-top keeps full form at Y=0.

settingsLayout.notes: Lock gallery card size (aspect+fraction), gallery→caption gap 20pt, and section spacing before 「저장 · 공유 지도」.

fillThenCrop.notes: Scale save image so width == card width (keep native aspect). Crop height to card. Do NOT scale-Y independently.

dataCard.description: Title card cut off above frame; map + 6 data cards visible; elevation card top slightly visible (~100px).

simpleGrey.description: Same fill-width then crop; slight top trim + bottom clip; no stretch.

simpleColor.description: Same fill-width then crop as Simple Grey; no stretch.

dimOverlay.notes: Uniform black dim over whole thumb. Under title text and under selected check.

optionTitle.notes: v22 gallery: 13pt (was 17 full-bleed) for readability on ~42% width thumbs. White text only — no capsule.

selectedBadge.notes: Gallery uses compact check circle (not full 「선택 완료」 chip — too wide on small thumbs). Only on selected card. Drawn above dim.

pageDots.notes: Removed for gallery — dots redundant with peeking third card + free scroll.
